vo: You are probably wondering how you actually sell this. Fair question. Let me make it much less scary.
Selling is the easy part. You already have the product, and the product genuinely helps people. If something fixes a real problem for a real business, why would it be hard to sell?
People try many routes. They cold call. They send emails. They run ads. Some simply walk into local shops and say, I have a small AI system that could save you time. Are you interested?

And people are already doing it. Others have built a small system with Grok Bot and a page builder, and they are earning from local businesses. Ask in a community how they sell, and learn from the answers. You never have to invent the method alone.
Notice what all of those have in common. They ask. They say, I have this. Do you want it? That is the whole trick. Most people never get a yes because they never ask.

And here is why this is the laziest route. In three or four hours you can have an AI agent, a simple website, and a Facebook and Instagram page, all for your new agency. Grok Bot helps with every one of them.
Next, the customers. Let a Bot scrape a list of local leads. Let it set up the email accounts. Then let it write and send each message separately, one business at a time.
We humans love to make this complicated. We tell ourselves it cannot be this easy, that someone on the internet is exaggerating. So we never start. The steps are small. The hard part is beginning.
Yes, within a few hours you can have something to offer for a monthly fee. The price is yours to decide. Start low, learn what people say, and raise it later.
And it does not have to be restaurants. Gardeners, plumbers, shops, clinics. Any niche where you can see a problem and fix it. Because a Grok Bot agent can take on almost any small, repeatable job.
It can even build a website from scratch, with no coding experience from you. That one skill opens the door to the simplest offer of all.
One honest note. Cold messages are regulated in many countries. Use real business addresses, say clearly who you are, and always include an easy way to opt out. Lazy does not mean careless.
So let us look at that simplest offer step by step. I call it the website play.
